opening_question_spark: What happens when I water the garden after sleeping less than five hours?
book_transition: I grab the book to see what gives way first.
cta: Like and subscribe to grow more questions.
body: Attention starts slipping during simple tasks.
Following instructions becomes harder to track.
Forming new memories becomes more difficult.
Reaction time slows during everyday moments.
Mistakes and accidents become more likely.
Mood can shift toward irritability or sadness.
Hunger signals may pull toward heavier foods.
Blood sugar control can become harder over time.
Blood pressure may rise with repeated short nights.
Immune defenses can weaken against challenges.
Severe tiredness can trigger sudden microsleeps.
Your brain may briefly stop responding normally.
One short night often brings temporary effects.
But repeated nights under five hours strain many systems.
Sleep is essential maintenance, not empty time.
